name: Amazon Music
author: Helix
description: Needs Amazon developer access: the Amazon Music Web API is a closed beta. Search Amazon Music, see your playlists and library, and add their albums to Helix. Play opens the Amazon Music app.

auth.setup: Needs Amazon developer access to the Amazon Music Web API (closed beta). With it, make a Login with Amazon security profile and put its client_id, client_secret, the Security Profile ID (as api_key) and an allowed return URL (as redirect_uri) in config.json under music_plugins.amazon-music.
